prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1479; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in the claim file. Effective immediately, all communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, or settlement discussions, should be directed exclusively to our office and not to our client. Please do not contact our client directly for any reason.

We also request that you provide a complete copy of the liability policy covering the at-fault driver, including the declarations page, and confirm in writing the bodily injury policy limits available for this loss. This information is needed to evaluate our client's claim properly.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle damage appraisals, telematics or event data recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, and any repair or salvage records. Please suspend any routine destruction of these materials while the claim is pending. We look forward to your prompt written confirmation.
